•§lAggressive toward§r:
 -§lWild§r: §o(None)§r
 -§lTamed§r: Monsters, Owner's attackers, Owner's targets.

•§lMelee Attack§r:
 -§lDamage§r: 7-8
 
•Transform into a §lMossy Cobblestone Golem§r, when a wild cobblestone golem gets exposed to water for too long. And if it also surrounded by mossy cobblestone or moss block, the transformation will be

accelerated and become more effective.
 
•Transform into a §lCobbled Deepslate Golem§r when struck by lightning.
 
•Wild Cobblestone Golem can sleep during the night or thunderstorms.
 
•Tamed Cobblestone Golem can be sat down.
